content: Write a memo to staff announcing a new expense policy.

**MEMORANDUM**

**To:** All Staff
**From:** [Name], [Title]
**Date:** [Date]
**Subject:** New Expense Policy Effective [Date]

---

Beginning **[effective date]**, we are implementing an updated expense reimbursement policy. The new policy simplifies submission requirements, shortens reimbursement turnaround, and brings our practices in line with current audit standards.

**What's changing**

1. **New submission platform.** All expenses must be submitted through [system name]. Paper forms and email submissions will no longer be accepted after [date].
2. **Submission deadline.** Expenses must be submitted within **[30] days** of the transaction date. Submissions beyond this window require written approval from your department head.
3. **Receipts.** Itemized receipts are required for all expenses of **$[25]** or more. Credit card statements alone are not sufficient documentation.
4. **Pre-approval thresholds.** Any single expense over **$[500]**, as well as all travel and client entertainment, requires manager pre-approval.
5. **Per diem rates.** Meal and incidental expenses during travel will follow the standard per diem schedule outlined in the policy rather than actual-cost reimbursement.
6. **Reimbursement timing.** Approved expenses will be processed within **[10] business days** and paid via [direct deposit/payroll].

**What you need to do**

- Review the full policy, available at [link or location].
- Complete the brief [system name] training module by **[date]**; it takes approximately [15] minutes.
- Submit any outstanding expenses under the current process by **[date]**.

**Questions**

Optional live Q&A sessions will be held on [dates/times] — [registration details]. For individual questions, contact [name] at [email] or reach out to your manager.

Thank you for your attention to these changes. Clear and timely expense reporting helps us manage resources responsibly and get your money back to you faster.

---
